text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents. To get information from a database, we write queries, which are special commands. Data modeling means planning how data is structured before we build the database. Indexes help speed up searches, like an index in a book. Choosing the right database and design makes applications faster and easier to manage.
